description: Equivocation exclusion spans epochs, and duplicate op ids dedup (SCHEMA.md §4.1 M2 / KERNEL §4.5). a1 (epoch 1) and a2 (epoch 2) share author 'aa' and equal timestamp (30,0) with distinct op ids -> both are an equivocation group and are excluded from state even though they live in different epochs; a3 survives. The third order lists a3 twice to confirm op-id dedup collapses it to one apply.
